1. A method for automatically scheduling the timing of a plurality of brake tests (1), that succeed one another at time intervals, at a plurality of brakes (B1-B6) of a robot arm (9) which is equipped with a plurality of joints (L1-L6) and a plurality of links (G1-G7) connecting the joints (L1-L6) to one another and is connected to a robot controller (10) which is designed and configured to control the joints (L1-L6) and the brakes (B1-B6), in order to move the robot arm (9), the method comprising the steps of:
- configuring at least one individual parameter (P1-P6) for each individual brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) or together for at least two groups of brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6), wherein the parameter in question (P1-P6) is assigned at least one criterion (K1-K6), which is a property relevant for the safe operation of the brake (B1-B6),
- automatically initializing a brake test method which is associated with the robot arm (9) and which is provided to control the joints (L1-L6) and the brakes (B1-B6) of the robot arm (9) by means of the robot controller (10), thereby automatically moving the links (G1-G7) of the robot arm (9) according to a brake test program predetermined by the brake test method, and automatically controlling the brakes (B1-B6) as a function of the configured parameters (P1-P6), and
- automatically executing the initialized brake test method, depending on the configured parameters (P1-P6), during an operating time of the robot arm (9), in which the robot arm (9) is configured for its application-specific, intended use.
2. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that the brake test method is automatically initialized in such a way that, depending on the configured parameters (P1-P6), corresponding brake tests (1) are carried out at each individually configured brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) or at the brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) configured together in at least two groups at individual, different times (T1-T6) and/or in individual, different time intervals (At1-At6).
3. The method according to claim 1 or 2, characterized in that the brake test method is automatically initialized, based on at least one individually configured parameter (P1-P6) for each individual brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6), or
together for at least two groups of brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6), which is a criterion of the mounting position (ML) of the robot arm (9) in the state of the robot arm (9) configured for the application-specific, intended use.
4. The method according to one of claims 1 to 3, characterized in that the brake test method is automatically initialized, based on at least one individually configured parameter (P1-P6) for a single brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) or together for at least two groups of brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6), which is a criterion of the robot tool (4) fastened to the robot arm (9).
5. The method according to one of claims 1 to 4, characterized in that the brake test method is automatically initialized, based on at least one individually configured parameter (P1-P6) for a single brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6), or together for at least two groups of brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6), which is a criterion of the workplace (AP) in the region of which the robot arm (9) is configured in its application-specific, intended use.
6. The method according to one of claims 1 to 5, characterized in that the particular configured value of the individual parameter (P1-P6) is determined by a manual input at a control device (10) of the robot arm (9) and the manually entered value is stored automatically, so that it can be retrieved during the automatic initialization of the brake test method.
7. The method according to claim 6, characterized in that the particular configured value of the individual parameter (P1-P6) is directly the point in time (T1-T6) and/or the time interval (At1-At6) according to which the particular brake test (1) is to be carried out at the individually configured brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) or at the brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) configured together in at least two groups at their individual, different points in time (T1-T6) and/or in individual, different time intervals (At1-At6).
8. The method according to one of claims 1 to 7, characterized in that the configuration of the at least one individual parameter (P1-P6) for each individual brake of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) or together for at least two groups of brakes of the plurality of brakes (B1-B6) is possible only within a predefined permissible value range, in particular an input and/or a saving of values outside the predefined, permissible value range is automatically prevented.
9. The method according to one of claims 1 to 8, characterized in that the automatic execution of the initialized brake test method is carried out both as a function of the configured parameters (P1-P6) during an operating time of the robot arm (9), in which the robot arm (9) is configured for its application-specific, intended use, and is carried out as a function of measured values (W1-W6) which are detected during the operating time of the robot arm (9) from state measurements at the brakes (B1-B6) of the robot arm (9), in particular during a corresponding execution of the brake test method at the robot arm (9).
10. The method according to one of claims 1 to 9, characterized in that, in addition to an automatic execution of the initialized brake test method, an additional or alternative execution of the initialized brake test method can be initiated by supplying a signal externally of the robot (8), in particular a process state, and/or by a spatial trigger, which is in particular the reaching of an axis limit or an axis stop of a joint (L1-L6) of the robot arm (9).
11. The method according to one of claims 1 to 10, characterized in that a first weighting is assigned to the parameters (P1-P6) assigned to a particular brake (B1- B6) of a particular joint (L1-L6) of the robot arm (9) for this particular joint (L1-L6), and the parameters (P1-P6) of the at least one other brake (B1-B6) of another joint (L1-L6) of the robot arm (9) for this other joint (L1-L6) or these other joints (L1-L6) are assigned a weighting different from the first weighting.
12. A robot comprising a robot arm (9) having a plurality of joints (L1-L6) and a plurality of links (G1-G7) which are adjustable relative to one another by the movements of the joints (L1-L6) of the robot arm (9), wherein each driven joint (L1- L6) is assigned a motor (M1-M6) and a brake (B1-B6), wherein each motor (M1- M6) is designed to adjust the joint (L1-L6) assigned to it, specifically by means of automatic control of the motor (M1-M6), and comprising a robot controller (10) which is designed to automatically control the motors (M1-M6), in order to adjust the links (G1-G7) of the robot arm (9) automatically and individually relative to one another by means of driven movement of the joints (L1-L6), and to automatically control the brakes (B1-B6), in order to be able to individually brake the joints (L1- L6) of the robot arm (9) and hold them locked, wherein the robot controller (10) is designed and configured to carry out a method according to one of claims 1 to 11.
